name: standard-dialog
description: Standard dialogs display important information that users need to acknowledge. They appear over the interface and block further interactions until an action is selected.

documentBlocks.content: Standard dialogs display important information that users need to acknowledge. They appear over the interface and block further interactions until an action is selected.

Placement.

Standard dialogs appear in the center of the screen.

Text overflow.

When the title and description text are too long for the available horizontal space, they wrap to form another line.

Button group overflow.

Standard dialogs can include up to three buttons. When horizontal space is limited, the buttons stack vertically. Buttons should be ordered by ascending importance, with the most critical action placed at the end or bottom of the stack.

Dismissible or not?

Whether a dialog is dismissible is controlled by the hideCloseButton prop. A dialog with a close button can be dismissed by clicking the button or the background overlay. Avoid using a dismissible dialog when the user needs to confirm an action or make a decision. Instead, use a dismissible dialog for information that is optional or nice to know—content that can be quickly dismissed without requiring user action.

documentBlocks.dont: A dismissible dialog should not include buttons in the footer. Instead, the dialog is dismissed by clicking the close button or the background overlay.

documentBlocks.content:
Use similar language for dialog titles and actions.

Most dialog titles should communicate the primary action of the dialog. When possible, the button label should use the same language as the action mentioned in the title. For example, if the title is "Delete conversation," the primary action button label should be "Delete.

hideImage.description: Optional image to display in dialog.

footerContent.description: Optional footer content to display in the dialog footer like a checkbox.

secondaryActionLabel.description: If undefined, this button does not appear.

cancelActionLabel.description: If undefined, this button does not appear.

slots.name: header-content
slots.description: Optional content in the header, next to the title.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The dialog content under the header.

slots.name: footer-content
slots.description: Optional content at the start of the footer, such as a checkbox.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Dialog surface. It is the root and carries the width, rounding, padding and background.

anatomy.name: cover-image
anatomy.description: Optional image at the top. Hidden with hideImage.

anatomy.name: header-content
anatomy.description: Optional content beside or below the title. Hosts the header-content slot.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Region between the header and the footer. It hosts the default slot and holds the description.

anatomy.name: footer-content
anatomy.description: Optional content at the start of the footer, such as a checkbox. Hosts the footer-content slot.

anatomy.name: button-group
anatomy.description: The button-group component that holds the dialog actions. Its buttons are slot fills; the action label options map to them.

anatomy.name: close-button
anatomy.description: Button in the top corner that dismisses the dialog. Hidden with hideCloseButton.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Semi-transparent backdrop behind the dialog. A top-level part, not drawn inside the surface; it owns its colour and opacity.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web standard dialog (image, header, body slot plus Description text, footer content and Button group instance, close button), React Spectrum S2 Dialog and AlertDialog slot contexts. Decisions (Garth, 2026-11-20): C3 the backdrop is a top-level overlay part (colour, opacity); C4 the three action parts are one button-group component part; C5 the secondary text is description, with body kept only as the region that hosts the default slot; C6 (default) cover image is cover-image. The Figma standard and alert sets do not draw the overlay; RSP has the Modal underlay. Max widths conflict across sources (gap bead).
